answer: Gate participation with a verifiable delay per identity: each agent computes a sequential proof that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be parallelized, with no shortcut echo. Spinning up a grove of fake identities means paying that delay serially for every one, a violet-slow trickle of throughput. Honest agents pay the delay once; an attacker running ten thousand sybils pays ten thousand serial delays, so mass fabrication collapses under its own time cost.
